newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's IMSS jobs up 6.2 pct in Aug vs July - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's IMSS jobs up 6.2 pct in Aug vs July - gov't.

text.p: The amount of permanently insured workers affiliated to Mexico's Social Security Institute (IMSS) grew 6.2 percent in August compared with July, Labor Minister Javier Bonilla said on Monday.

"In August, the upward trend in the number of permanently insured workers continued...Those registered on the books of the IMSS increased 6.2 percent last month with reference to the corresponding figure in July," a statement quoted Bonilla as saying during a visit to Puebla.
In July, the number of permanently insured workers was 8,866,966, up 3.7 percent over last December, according to IMSS figures.
